summary: Candidate is a broad comparative benchmarking session that subsumes three narrower peer skills: isolation level performance comparison, workload contention scaling, and benchmark workload execution. All four skills share identical asset_type (session_skill), granularity (session), asset_node_id (workflow_skill), asset_level (2), domain (default), task_family (performance_evaluation/benchmarking), and method_family (comparative_benchmarking). The candidate's 5-step workflow encompasses the core measurement and normalization logic that unifies the three peers' distinct evaluation angles (isolation levels, contention scaling, workload execution). Merging consolidates overlapping measurement infrastructure and avoids redundant benchmark harness setup across three separate skills.
